svg.text: MOSFET module — where the six heater wires land
ANMBEST dual-MOSFET switch, component side up, LED at the top. Wire numbers match wiring-12v.svg. The + / − labels are printed on the back, so they are chipped onto the screws here.
wire 4 · −V → VIN− (comes down onto the inner screw)
wire 9 · VOUT− → ring (drops off the inner screw, under the board)
wire 7 · pin 14 → J1 GND (upper big hole)
wire 6 · pin 12 → J1 TRIG/PWM (lower big hole)
LED lights while GPIO18 is high
Confirm + / − with a meter before powering (module unpowered):
1. VIN+ to VOUT+ beeps — the two + screws are one straight bus, so whichever column beeps across both blocks is the + column.
2. VIN− to the J1 GND hole beeps; VIN− to VOUT− reads open — that is the leg the MOSFET switches, closed only while GPIO18 is high.
